{{Top}}
[[File:Dejarik_table_btm.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A typical hologame table]]
A '''hologame table''' was a simple table that comprised a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] generator within a table-sized cylindrical base, with a black-and-white checkerboard pattern on the top surface.

Used in the game of [[Dejarik/Legends|Dejarik]], [[Holomonster/Legends|holomonsters]]&mdash;full-color, three-dimensional hologram playing pieces measuring between 5 and 30 centimeters tall&mdash;would be projected on the board. The pieces all resembled creatures, real and mythic, from throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including the [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Mantellian Savrip]], [[Grimtaash/Legends|Grimtaash]] the [[Molator/Legends|Molator]], [[Ghhhk/Legends|Ghhhk]], [[Houjix/Legends|Houjix]], [[Ng'ok/Legends|Ng'ok]], [[Kintan strider/Legends|Kintan strider]], [[K'lor'slug/Legends|K'lor'slug]], and the [[Monnok]]. These pieces, when moved by the player, acted out the moves as if specimens of their species. If the pieces were not used for a certain amount of time or the game was abandoned by both players, they would simulate boredom.
